tenderSchedule.title: Providing 14 nos of drivers with HMV driving license for vehicles pertaining to Hotline SD and RT Adl Dn, Rajajinagar and Hubballi RT Division, Hubballi
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for providing services of 1) Twelve drivers with Heavy Motor Vehicle driving license for driving Tempo Traveler, Insulated Aerial work Platform Truck, Insulated Sky ladder vehicle and tools Transportation vehicle pertaining to 6 Nos of Hotline Sub-Divisions KPTCL. 2) Two drivers with Heavy Motor Vehicle driving license for driving Mobile Switchyard Equipment Testing Van with Integrated Testing equipments pertaining to RT Additional Division, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru and Hubballi RT Division, Hubballi.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CGM Tech Corporate Office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Conference hall, 11th floor, Indhana Bhavana, KPTCL

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computerwell in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of eProcurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches
The tenderer should be a registered company under Indian Companies Act 1956 /2013 (optional)
The Tenderer should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) registration and shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration
Tenderers shall not take any deviation on the Clauses listed in the NIT
Tenderers shall upload legible documents only
Refer Tender documents for detailed criteria, terms and conditions
All other terms and conditions as per tender document
The tenderer shall quote service charges as percentage of value of Annual Tender provided that the service charges shall be between 5% to 10% only, else such a bid will be rejected

The tenderer should be registered under GST Act, proof of which should be submitted along with the tender document and should submit proof of the Permanent Account Number (PAN) assigned by the Income Tax Department

Power of Attorney shall be sent in original to Chief General Manager (Technical), KPTCL, Bangalore so as to reach after the last submission date & on or before the date & time of opening Techno commercial Bids

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have provided manpower services in State / Central Government Departments / Organizations, Public sector / Private Companies / Banks and Financial Institutions, KPTCL / ESCOMs of contract value not less than Rs.44.39 Lakhs per annum evidencing the same, satisfactorily, to at least one reputed Organization for a minimum period of One year during the last three financial years. The experience certificates issued by competent officers(not below the rank of EE or equivalent cadre) are to be uploaded.

The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years (in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) an average annual financial turnover of Rs.88.78Lakhs. Documentary proof certified by a Chartered Accountant is to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Balance sheets, profit and loss statements and Audited CA certificate of Annual turnover shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be a reputed manpower providing agency having valid registration certificate issued by Department of Labour,GOK for providing manpower services. Documentary proof in the form of certificate of registration issued by GOK is to be uploaded. Further, in the event of award, the successful bidder shall obtain the Certificate of Registration under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 from Department of Labour, GoK for the services specified in the tender
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: valid registration certificate issued by Department of Labour,GOK

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall comply with all the provisions under Labour Laws such as EPF, ESI, Payment of Wages, Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 etc.. and provide the necessary proof of its compliance every month together with the bill. In case the tenderer fails to provide such proof of payments made to the personnel in which month it is due and such default occurs for more than 3 months in any continuous period of 12 months, the same will be considered as Breach of Contract. The tenderer shall comply with all the statutory requirements evidencing the same. The self-declaration letter by the tenderer in the letterhead of the firm is to be uploaded along with the ESI and EPF registration certificate
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Comply with provisions of Labour Laws such EPF,ESI,Payment of Wages,Contract Labour(Regulation and Abolition)Act,1970etc

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer whose contracts have been terminated / foreclosed /blacklisted / penalized by any Organizations during the last Three years due to non fulfillment of contractual obligations / deficiency in service are not eligible to participate in the tender. The tenderer should clearly specify and upload self declaration letter in writing in the letterhead of the firm, stating that they do not fall under this category.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part or JV may result in rejection of bid. Bidders should upload the self declaration stating the above and upload the same along with the other documents in the relevant field in the KPP portal, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self declaration or certificate in this regard

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall upload the Power of Attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.500/- non-judicial stamp paper. Further Power of Attorney shall be sent in original to Chief General Manager(Technical), KPTCL, Bangalore so as to reach after the last submission date & on or before the date & time of opening Techno commercial Bids. Note: The offer of the Tenderer shall be rejected in the following cases 1.If the Power of Attorney is furnished on the stamp paper of value below Rs 500/- 2.In case the date of execution of Power of Attorney is not mentioned. 3.In case the date of execution of Power of Attorney is prior to the date of purchase of Stamp paper. 4.In case the Power of Attorney is submitted without the signature of the Power of Attorney holder and signature of the person who has authorized the Power of Attorney holder.5.In case tender documents including techno commercial sheets are signed by the different person other than the Attorney holder or the person who has authorized the Attorney holder
